notes: Sources: docs/design/device-connector-2026-10-31.md:173-198 (§4.5 manifest: schema tag, deviceId, capability map, limits, auth; an undeclared capability is unavailable) and docs/design/device-adapter-contract-draft.md:76-103 (§5 adds the protocol block and the render.* vocabulary, and requires vendor extensions to live under vendor.<name>.*). max_frame_bytes is bounded at 64 KiB by the adapter requirements (device-connector-2026-10-31.md:246-253 §4.6, row 3). vehicle.* is absent because it needs granted_by: oem (device-connector-2026-10-31.md:191,198).
